title: Inhalable Plant Exosome-like Nanoparticles fromAmeliorate Acute Lung Injury via Redox Modulation and Immune Reprogramming.
snippet: : Acute lung injury (ALI) features oxidative stress, macrophage dysfunction, and barrier disruption, with limited safe therapies. Plant-derived exosome-like nanovesicles (PENs) delivered noninvasively to the lung are promising but understudied.: In vitro, HELNs were evaluated for their ability to scavenge ROS, restore mitochondrial membrane potential (MMP)....
